Syndra|mid.identity: Magic damage burst mage. Dark Sphere (Q) summons a sphere that explodes, Force of Will (W) grabs a sphere or minion and throws it while slowing, Scatter the Weak (E) knocks back enemies and spheres (which stun whoever they hit), and Unleashed Power (R) sends every sphere at a target. She builds stacks that upgrade her abilities (passive Transcendent).
Syndra|mid.playstyle: Lane-control and burst mage. Syndra pokes from range, stuns with Q + E and one-shots a target with her ultimate.
Syndra|mid.early_game: Poke with Q when your opponent comes to last hit and farm distant minions with W. Keep E (and a sphere nearby) to stun an assassin who engages you. Build your passive stacks by hitting champions.
Syndra|mid.level_1: Dark Sphere (Q) first. Poke and farm.
Syndra|mid.level_2: Scatter the Weak (E). Q → E: the sphere is launched and stuns. It's your main offensive and defensive tool.
Syndra|mid.level_3: Force of Will (W). Full combo: Q → E (stun) → W → Q.
Syndra|mid.level_6: Unleashed Power: every sphere hits the target. The more spheres, the bigger the burst. Combo: Q → E → W → R.
power_spikes: First completed item: burst that kills carries.
Syndra|mid.lane_plan: Poke with Q, control the wave and keep E against engages. Push, then join your jungler or objectives. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you come back quickly after pushing.
Syndra|mid.trading: Short trade: Q poke. All-in: Q → E → W → R. Defense: E on the incoming assassin. Give up on it against assassins who dodge your stun.
threats: Fizz, Katarina, Ekko and Locke: hard matchups.
Ganks while your E is on cooldown.
mistakes: Casting your ultimate with too few spheres.
Staying in an assassin's range without E available.

matchup_notes.Viktor: Poke him and stun him when he steps up.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep E for her R engage.
matchup_notes.Zed: Keep E for the moment he reappears after his ultimate.
matchup_notes.Fizz: He dodges your stun: keep E for the end of his hop.
matchup_notes.Katarina: Stun her when she lands on her dagger.

Syndra|mid.mid_game: Picks and zone control around objectives. One-shot carries who walk forward without vision.
Syndra|mid.late_game: Burst the enemy carry with your ultimate, protect yourself with E. Stay behind your frontline.
Syndra|mid.ahead: Roam, create picks and take objectives.
Syndra|mid.behind: Farm, poke safely and look for picks.
Syndra|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to control your lane and one-shot carries with your ultimate.
Syndra|mid.final_tip: Always keep a sphere and your E for the enemy engage: the stun saves you.
